summary: What it is: a real (if tiny) RV overnight stopover - a few gravel back-in sites by a storage business off I-57, still operating (Google review + owner reply ~July 2026) - not an RV rental business. But its website ezcampnow.com no longer resolves, Facebook is the only page (no rates), and Google has only 10 reviews: fails the presence test -> DROP CANDIDATE. No rate found anywhere (RV Life $$ stored is the only price indicator).
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (no live web presence, private): the operator domain ezcampnow.com does not resolve (NXDOMAIN, 2026-11-12); the only page is Facebook ('EZ Camp, located off Interstate-57, hosts WiFi and power...', 184 followers, no rates); Google 'EZ Camp' is open with a phone (618-927-3660) but has only 10 reviews (presence by Google needs 25+). Price indicator: RV Life $$ (stored) only - no posted rate anywhere; the old note's '~$25' had no source and is removed.

WHAT IT IS: an RV overnight stop, not an RV rental/delivery business - Google categorises it 'Campground'; reviews describe 'Five simple, bare bones, BACK IN, all gravel spots in front of a large storage unit' (2021) and 'Stayed in site 5, level, full hookup' (~2026-07).

SITES/HOOKUPS: stored count 10 and 50 A / water / sewer are note-derived; a 2021 review says five sites and 'No water, but improvements are underway', recent reviews say full hookup. No operator statement read - groups left untouched.

PIN: stored 37.994,-88.95 is ~50 m from Google's 37.99449,-88.95047, on IL 14; a 2021 review says 'Map coordinates are WAY off. It's further down the road.' Imagery at the pin shows storage/industrial lots on both sides of IL 14 and no identifiable RV pads - pin unverified, no target given.
